draft.summary: Ask customers for feedback after a delivered order
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Story (created as Task; this Jira project has no Story type).

Phase: 2.

Marketing only hears about complaints on Instagram, after the damage is done. She wants direct feedback and will read the reviews privately first.

## User Story
As a customer, I want to rate my order after it arrives, so that the bakery learns what I thought of it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Request after delivery** (Happy path) — An order is delivered. Expected: the customer receives one request to rate it from one to five stars, a few hours later.
- AC2: **Optional comment** (Happy path) — A customer opens the feedback request. Expected: they can give a star rating and may add a comment.
- AC3: **Once per order** (Edge case) — A feedback request was already sent for a delivered order. Expected: no second request is sent for that order.
- AC4: **Reviews are private** (Happy path) — A customer submits a review. Expected: the review is not shown on the website.

## Business Rules
Sent for every delivered order, once per order, a few hours after delivery. Rating is one to five stars with an optional comment. Reviews are private and not shown on the website.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
Open question (Paula Vega): which channel carries the request, email or in the app? Open question: how many hours after delivery? Deferred: loyalty program idea (00:09:30), no details.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met.
- [ ] Developer testing and sanity check completed.
- [ ] Peer review approved.
- [ ] QA validation approved.
- [ ] Demo completed.
- [ ] Documentation updated, if applicable.
- [ ] Release status and evidence recorded.
